name: Chainport
description_short: Bridge between EVM chains and Cardano.
description_long: Security-focused cross-chain bridge supporting 25+ blockchain ecosystems, with Cardano among them. Tokens can be ported between any supported chains without reverting to the original chain. Supports several bridging architectures — wrapped asset bridging, native token bridging, hybrid, private and whitelabel bridges — and charges a 0.3% fee per port. Security model keeps up to 98% of funds in multi-sig cold storage via Gnosis Safe and Fireblocks MPC, with contracts audited by Certik, Trail of Bits, Zokyo, and Cyber Unit. Provides wADA, a wrapped version of ada on EVM chains, and a public transparency dashboard with proof-of-reserves. Built by Dcentralab.
